subject: Branding assets, rights confirmation & SLA / incident playbook for marketplace listing
messages:
From: partners-aws-marketplace@amazon.com
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 3 Sep 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Marketplace listing checklist: branding, claims, support hours, and incident playbook

Hi Vanessa,

We're preparing BlueStratus Health's listing in the AWS Marketplace and need a few items to complete the compliance checklist before the listing window: 

- Finalized branding assets (logo variations, SVG/PNG, color palette).
- Confirmation of usage rights / trademark attestation from BlueStratus.
- A short paragraph (<=150 words) summarizing any claims about uptime, certifications, or data handling we can display on the listing.
- Support coverage and SLA language we should include (hours, response/priority matrix, escalation contact).
- An incident response playbook or stub describing how product incidents are handled (this can be redacted for sensitive details).

Can you share the assets and the statements by EOD Friday PT? If there are legal or procurement constraints we should be aware of, loop them in.

Thanks,
Elaine Kim
AWS Marketplace Programs
partners-aws-marketplace@amazon.com

From: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
To: partners-aws-marketplace@amazon.com
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 3 Sep 2025 11:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Marketplace listing checklist: branding, claims, support hours, and incident playbook

Thanks Elaine — sharing the initial package now. Attaching: BS-Brand-Pack-v2.zip (logos, svg, color guidance) and Incident-Response-Runbook-Redwood.pdf (redacted playbook).

Quick answers inline:
- Usage rights: BlueStratus has granted Redwood a license to display their trademarks and logos on marketplace listings and co-marketing materials. We will attach the signed attestation separately.
- Claims blurb (150 words):
  BlueStratus Health provides a cloud-native clinical data ingestion and de-identification pipeline optimized for healthcare analytics. Deployed on secure infrastructure, BlueStratus supports HIPAA-compliant data flows and offers configurable retention controls. Typical deployment SLA: 99.5% availability for processing pipelines, subject to fair-use thresholds and scheduled maintenance windows.

- Support/SLA stub: 9x5 business-hours support (Mon–Fri, 6am–6pm PT) with standard escalation to Engineering; optional 24x7 support is available under an add-on. Response times: P1 (1 hour), P2 (4 hours), P3 (1 business day).

We are sending trademark-attestation for BlueStratus as a signed PDF immediately after this message. cc: Laura for legal confirmation on wording.

Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Partnerships | Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
Attachment(s): BS-Brand-Pack-v2.zip (branding assets), Incident-Response-Runbook-Redwood.pdf (redacted)

From: ben_carter@redwood.ai
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, partners-aws-marketplace@amazon.com
Date: Thu, 4 Sep 2025 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Marketplace listing checklist: branding, claims, support hours, and incident playbook

Vanessa / Elaine — quick product/ops note on the SLA text:

- The 99.5% availability figure is fine as a listing-level statement, but we should add the phrase "subject to customer-configured retention and peak ingestion windows" to avoid narrow edge-case claims.
- For marketplace display, AWS typically expects a single line for support hours and an escalation contact. Recommend we provide: "Business hours support: Mon–Fri 6am–6pm PT. For P1 incidents call +1-415-555-0147 (ops escalation). Optional 24x7 commercial support available."
- Incident playbook: please confirm whether we can share an anonymized timeline example (detect -> triage -> mitigate -> postmortem) for the listing, or if we should keep it generic. Generic is safer for the public page.

I'll help scope the optional 24x7 offering in the partner addendum if BlueStratus wants it listed as available.

-ben
Ben Carter
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference

From: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
Cc: partners-aws-marketplace@amazon.com
Date: Fri, 5 Sep 2025 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Marketplace listing checklist: branding, claims, support hours, and incident playbook

Thanks — I reviewed the attestation and brand pack. A couple of legal notes: 

- Trademark attestation needs to be signed by an authorized BlueStratus officer (we have the draft, see attached: Trademark-Attestation-BS-signed.pdf). Please confirm signatory name and title to appear on the public record where required.
- Claims language: avoid using specific regulatory phrases like "HIPAA-compliant" without a clarifying parenthetical (e.g., "configured to support HIPAA workflows; customers are responsible for their controls"). Recommend the following short blurb for listing copy: "BlueStratus enables cloud-native clinical data ingestion and configurable de-identification pipelines; customers control retention and access settings."

If BlueStratus wants to claim formal certification, we need a certificate or third-party audit reference.

Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel | Redwood Inference

From: partners-aws-marketplace@amazon.com
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai, elaine.kim@bluestratushealth.com
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 8 Sep 2025 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Marketplace listing checklist: branding, claims, support hours, and incident playbook

Hi all,

Thanks — the materials look complete for the initial review. A few final items before we approve the public listing window: 

- Please confirm the exact contact string to display on the AWS listing for incidents (we need one phone or amailto contact).
- We will display the support hours as received; please confirm whether to show the optional 24x7 support as "available (contact vendor)" or hide it until a contract is signed.
- Trademark attestation is accepted (we have received the signed PDF).

Assuming we get the confirmation on the contact string and 24x7 flag by EOD Wednesday PT, we can schedule the listing window for next Tuesday (2025-09-16).

Regards,
AWS Marketplace Listing Team
partners-aws-marketplace@amazon.com
